edges.reason: Constructor assigns the immutable Uniswap router.
Constructor assigns the created Uniswap pair.
Constructor sets maxTransactionAmount.
Constructor derives swapTokensAtAmount from total supply arithmetic.
Constructor sets maxWallet.
Constructor sets the marketing wallet.
Constructor sets the dev wallet.
Constructor computes buyTotalFees.
Constructor computes sellTotalFees.
StartTrading sets tradingActive to true.
StartTrading sets swapEnabled to true.
StartTrading seeds lastLpBurnTime from block.timestamp.
removeLimits flips limitsInEffect, gated by onlyOwner.
disableTransferDelay flips transferDelayEnabled, gated by onlyOwner.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount writes swapTokensAtAmount after supply-based bounds.
updateMaxTxnAmount writes maxTransactionAmount after scaling by 1e18.
updateMaxWalletAmount writes maxWallet after scaling by 1e18.
excludeFromMaxTransaction writes the exemption mapping, gated by onlyOwner.
updateBuyFees recomputes buyTotalFees, gated by onlyOwner.
updateSellFees recomputes sellTotalFees, gated by onlyOwner.
excludeFromFees writes the fee exemption mapping, gated by onlyOwner.
Private helper writes the AMM pair mapping.
updateMarketingWallet changes the ETH-receiving marketing wallet.
updateDevWallet changes the ETH-receiving dev wallet.
_transfer toggles the swapping guard around swapBack.
_transfer writes the per-origin last transfer block used by the anti-bot delay.
_transfer accumulates marketing fee tokens.
_transfer accumulates liquidity fee tokens.
_transfer accumulates dev fee tokens.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens updates lastLpBurnTime from block.timestamp.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens updates lastManualLpBurnTime from block.timestamp.
setAutoLPBurnSettings sets percentForLPBurn.
setAutoLPBurnSettings sets lpBurnEnabled.
setAutoLPBurnSettings sets lpBurnFrequency.
swapBack resets tokensForMarketing after payout.
swapBack resets tokensForLiquidity after payout.
swapBack resets tokensForDev after payout.
Constructor mints the total supply to msg.sender.
msg.sender originates token transfers routed through _transfer.
StartTrading timestamps the LP burn schedule using block.timestamp.
_transfer compares block.timestamp against lpBurnFrequency to trigger burns.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens uses block.timestamp as burn time.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens gates burns on block.timestamp cooldown.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the router deadline.
_transfer keys the anti-bot delay on tx.origin, which is externally controllable via relays.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates to the private setter.
_transfer calls swapBack while state may still allow reentry on the pair.
swapBack forwards ETH to devWallet via low-level call.
swapBack forwards remaining balance to marketingWallet via low-level call.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens.
swapBack calls addLiquidity with the liquidity portion.
_transfer triggers autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens which makes an external pair call.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() after transferring tokens.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() after transferring tokens.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router fee-on-transfer swap.
addLiquidity invokes the router addLiquidityETH.
devWallet low-level call can reenter _transfer/swapBack before state is settled.
marketingWallet low-level call can reenter token transfer logic.
StartTrading restricts callers through the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
removeLimits restricts callers through onlyOwner.
disableTransferDelay restricts callers through onlyOwner.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount restricts callers through onlyOwner.
updateMaxTxnAmount restricts callers through onlyOwner.
updateMaxWalletAmount restricts callers through onlyOwner.
excludeFromMaxTransaction restricts callers through onlyOwner.
updateBuyFees restricts callers through onlyOwner.
updateSellFees restricts callers through onlyOwner.
excludeFromFees restricts callers through onlyOwner.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair restricts callers through onlyOwner.
updateMarketingWallet restricts callers through onlyOwner.
updateDevWallet restricts callers through onlyOwner.
setAutoLPBurnSettings restricts callers through onlyOwner.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens restricts callers through onlyOwner.
from parameter drives balance/limit and fee-exemption checks in _transfer.
to parameter selected as buy/sell destination in _transfer.
amount parameter feeds fee multiplication/division and limit comparisons.
percent parameter drives the burn calculation in manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
_frequencyInSeconds parameter sets the LP burn interval.
_percent parameter sets percentForLPBurn.
_Enabled parameter toggles lpBurnEnabled.
newMarketingWallet parameter redirects future ETH payouts.
newWallet parameter redirects future dev ETH payouts.
newNum parameter is scaled by 10**18 when setting maxTransactionAmount.
newNum parameter is scaled by 10**18 when setting maxWallet.
newAmount parameter is validated against percentages of total supply.
_transfer computes the local fees from amount and total fee percents.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens computes amountToBurn from pair balance and percent.
amountToBurn is transferred to the dead address before pair.sync().
swapBack derives the liquidity token portion from accumulated balances.
swapBack derives the ETH-swap token amount by subtracting liquidity tokens.
liquidityTokens is passed into addLiquidity.
amountToSwapForETH is passed into swapTokensForEth.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter from is only meaningful inside _transfer and should be merged into that function node.
Parameter to is only used by _transfer for buy/sell and limit decisions.
Parameter amount is consumed by _transfer fee and limit arithmetic.
percent is exclusively used to compute the burn amount in that function.
Burn frequency parameter only configures state inside the setter.
Burn percent parameter only configures state inside the setter.
Enable flag only toggles lpBurnEnabled inside the setter.
New marketing wallet parameter only reassigns the marketing wallet state.
New dev wallet parameter only reassigns the dev wallet state.
New max transaction number only affects maxTransactionAmount assignment.
New max wallet number only affects maxWallet assignment.
New swap amount only affects swapTokensAtAmount assignment.
Local fee amount lives only within _transfer execution.
amountToBurn directly precedes and determines the pair.sync() call.
liquidityTokens is created in swapBack solely to feed addLiquidity.
amountToSwapForETH is created in swapBack solely to feed swapTokensForEth.
